commitResults.messageTitle: Changed name and added greeting + bye

commitResults.messageBody: Rename the starter chatbot references to Buddy, update setup documentation, fill the local agent profile, and ignore compiled class files.
Read user commands continuously, echo non-bye input, and exit cleanly when the user enters bye.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level 2 task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody: Store entered task descriptions in memory and show numbered tasks when the user enters the list command.
Introduce a Task class and support mark and unmark commands so Buddy can track completed tasks.
Extract command helpers, keep task-number parsing explicit, and update the user guide to describe the supported commands.
Support todo, deadline, and event tasks using subclasses of Task so each task type controls its own display format.
Move task storage and lookup into TaskList so Buddy focuses on command flow while task bounds checking stays in one place.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add BuddyException for user-facing error messages
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduces a checked exception so command handling can signal invalid
input with a clear message instead of silently guessing what the user
meant (e.g. previously any unrecognised command was treated as a todo).

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid commands and arguments with BuddyException
commitResults.messageBody:
Replaces the old fallback behaviour (any unrecognised input, including
bare "todo"/"deadline"/"event" with no arguments, silently became a
Todo) with explicit validation:
- unknown commands are rejected instead of being treated as a todo
- empty todo/deadline/event descriptions are rejected
- deadlines without "/by" and events without "/from ... /to ..." are
  rejected, with an example of the correct format in the message
- mark/unmark now report a specific reason for non-numeric or
  out-of-range task numbers instead of one generic message

TaskList.getTask now throws BuddyException instead of
IllegalArgumentException so its error message reaches the user the
same way as every other validation error.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-5': handle errors with BuddyException
Move classes into buddy, buddy.task, and buddy.exception packages
commitResults.messageBody:
File move only, no content changes yet, so the rename is easy to
review separately from the package-declaration/import updates that
follow.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add package declarations and imports for the new package layout
commitResults.messageBody:
Buddy now lives in package buddy, the Task hierarchy and TaskList in
buddy.task, and BuddyException in buddy.exception, matching the folder
structure from the previous commit. Behaviour is unchanged; verified
by re-running the same manual command sequence used for Level-5.
